macros.name: axescolor
macros.doc: User can change the axes color by redefining the \axescolor declaration.

macros.name: axeslabelcolor
macros.doc: User can change the color of labels by redefining the \axeslabelcolor declaration.

macros.name: axeslabelmathalphabet
macros.doc: User can change the math alphabet of labels by redefining the \axeslabelmathalphabet declaration.

macros.name: axeslabelmathversion
macros.doc: User can change the mathversion of labels by redefining the \axeslabelmathversion declaration.

macros.name: axeslabelsize
macros.doc: User can change the size of labels by redefining the \axeslabelsize declaration.

macros.name: axesthickness
macros.doc: Length determining the thickness of axes (default 1 pt).

macros.name: axislabelsep
macros.doc: Distance between tags and cut marks, measured in \unitlength units; the distance between axes and tags equals \ticssize+\axislabelsep.

macros.name: cartesianaxes
macros.doc: draws the coordinate axes corresponding to the [x0, y0] × [x1, y1] rectangle.

macros.name: cartesianreference
macros.doc: \cartesianreference declares Cartesian coordinates (default).

macros.name: changereferencesystem
macros.doc: The \changereferencesystem changes from the active reference system.

macros.name: defaultplotdivs
macros.doc: All commands drawing conic sections or arcs divide the curve in \defaultplotdivs pieces (8, by default).

macros.name: defaultPut
macros.doc: fixes the default position for \Put, \multiPut and \multiPlot commands.

macros.name: degreesangles
macros.doc: \degreesangles declares that angles are measured in degrees.

macros.name: degreespolarlabels
macros.doc: \degreespolarlabels when this declaration is active, angular labels in polar grids are printed in degrees.

macros.name: draftPictures
macros.doc: \draftPictures disables Picture commands, showing only the picture area.

macros.name: externalaxes
macros.doc: Cartesian axes lies on y = y0 and x = x0.

macros.name: gridcolor
macros.doc: \gridcolor determines the color of main divisions in the grid (regardless of the axes color).

macros.name: highestlabel
macros.doc: declares the highest label to be equal to height of text.

macros.name: internalaxes
macros.doc: Cartesian axes lies on y = 0 and x = 0 (default).

macros.name: makegrid
macros.doc: If the \makegrid declaration is active, then \cartesianaxes plots a Cartesian grid.

macros.name: makelabels
macros.doc: \makelabels when this declaration is active, numerical labels are printed (default).

macros.name: makenogrid
macros.doc: If the \makenogrid declaration is active, then \cartesianaxes plots only the axes (default).

macros.name: makenolabels
macros.doc: \makenolabels when this declaration is active, numerical labels are not printed.

macros.name: makenotics
macros.doc: \makenotics when this declaration is active, divisions of axes are not marked.

macros.name: pictcolor
macros.doc: select a color without spurious spaces.

macros.name: pictcolor
macros.doc: select a color without spurious spaces.

macros.name: Pictlabelsep
macros.doc: \Pictlabelsep determines the distance between the graphical object and the given point.

macros.name: PlotPointsOfFunction
macros.doc: By default, \PlotPointsOfFunction plot points as a filled circle of diameter 0.1\unitlength.

macros.name: plotxtic
macros.doc: plot a tic for the given x coordinate.

macros.name: plotytic
macros.doc: plot a tic for the given y coordinate.

macros.name: pointmarkdiam
macros.doc: \pointmarkdiam is the size of points printed by \PlotPointsOfFunction, measured in \unitlength units.

macros.name: polarcoor
macros.doc: \polarcoor changes from polar to rectangular coordinates.

macros.name: polarreference
macros.doc: \polarreference declares polar coordinates.

macros.name: Polyline
macros.doc: \Polyline draws polygonal lines.

macros.name: printxlabel
macros.doc: print the required label at the given x coordinate.

macros.name: printxticlabel
macros.doc: print a tic and the required label at the given x coordinate.

macros.name: printylabel
macros.doc: print the required label at the given y coordinate.

macros.name: printyticlabel
macros.doc: print a tic and the required label at the given y coordinate.

macros.name: qCurve
macros.doc: draw a smooth curve between the points (x0 , y0 ) and (x1 , y1 ), with tangent vectors (u0 , v0 ) and (u1 , v1 ), respectively.

macros.name: radiansangles
macros.doc: The \radiansangles and \degreesangles declarations determine if angles are interpreted as radians or degrees.

macros.name: radianspolarlabels
macros.doc: \radianspolarlabels when this declaration is active, angular labels in polar grids are printed in radians (default).

macros.name: regularPolygon
macros.doc: makes the regular polygon with the given radius and sides.

macros.name: regularPolygon
macros.doc: makes the regular polygon with the given radius and sides.

macros.name: rlabelpos
macros.doc: Relative position of labels in polar axis.

macros.name: rotateaxes
macros.doc: rotates the axes.

macros.name: runitdivisions
macros.doc: Number of subdivisions of the unit in the polar axis (must a positive integer).

macros.name: secundarygridcolor
macros.doc: \secundarygridcolor determines the color of secundary divisions in the grid.

macros.name: standardreferencesystem
macros.doc: The \standardreferencesystem declaration restores the standard reference.

macros.name: ticscolor
macros.doc: Color of the marks on axes (by default, black).

macros.name: ticssize
macros.doc: half the length of main axes cuts.

macros.name: ticsthickness
macros.doc: Thickness of the marks on axes (by default, 1pt).

macros.name: translateorigin
macros.doc: moves the origin to the specified coordinates.

macros.name: xlabelpos
macros.doc: Relative position of labels in x axis.

macros.name: xline
macros.doc: \xline, \xvector, \xtrivvector draw lines and vectors using the standard LaTeX syntax (but without any restriction in allowed parameters, that can be integer or decimal numbers, positive, negative or zero).

macros.name: xLINE
macros.doc: draws the line segment between the two points (x0 ,y0 ) and (x1 ,y1 ) (Cartesian or polar coordinates, in the active reference system).

macros.name: xtrivVECTOR
macros.doc: draws an arrow from point (x0,y0 ) to point (x1,y1 ).

macros.name: xunitdivisions
macros.doc: Number of subdivisions of the unit (in each axis).

macros.name: xVECTOR
macros.doc: draw an arrow between points (x0 ,y0 ) and (x1 ,y1 ).

macros.name: ylabelpos
macros.doc: Relative position of labels in y axis.

macros.name: zerotrivvector
macros.doc: draw a zero-length vector (an arrowhead) in direction (x,y).

macros.name: zerovector
macros.doc: draw a zero-length vector (an arrowhead) in direction (x,y).
